description: This file defines a React component for a skill validation interview UI in a Next.js application. It orchestrates multiple phases of an interview, including introductory content, question prompts with typing animation, processing indicators, and a completion screen. It manages user responses, simulated processing, and visual feedback for confidence and progress.

methods.name: mulberry32
methods.description: A small deterministic pseudo-random number generator used for subtle UI variations and animations, seeded for session consistency.
